ThingDef.label: Brightsap
ThingDef.description: A jar of refined, potent terrasap, named due to the vibrant glow it emits. When used as a fuel in a Terraforge, this sap can completely revitialize and restore the lifespan of various Terraweapons within it. It is also used as a catalyst for light-emitting Terratech plants. \n\nBrightsap can be used on any matured weapon within a Terravat. To use it, insert this sap as a fuel source, then insert the weapon you wish to revitalize.

ThingDef.label: Toxsap
ThingDef.description:
A jar of terrasap containing elements quite poisonous to most living beings. Despite the name, Toxsap does not share the same effect with synthetic tox creations, and instead is more akin to venoms and poisons you would find in animals and insects. 

Toxsap is very effective against non-Terratech factions, as other factions generally have little to no knowledge of curing the toxin. Very few can survive even moderates doses of it unscathed, and larger doses are almost always a death sentence. 
However, due to their superior understanding of Terratech, any Terratech faction can develop extremely effective antidotes, though these themselves also require access to Toxsap. This makes Toxsap an "equalizer" of sorts, as attempting to wipe out Terratech tribes also means wiping out this valuable knowledge. 
Toxsap is quite rare, and it's methods of growth is currently unknown, making it's primary source of acquisition either from a Terratech faction, or from a Spectra Tree. Due to it being "discovered" AFTER the Prima weapons were developed, Prima weapons are simply not strong enough to support this sap, and will not accept it. 
It is also a favorite of the smaller, savage Terratech tribes, making civil leverage of antidote knowledge all the more impactful. 

Use cases: Allows matured ranged weapons to fire venomous projectiles, and melee weapons to have a venomous coating. Creation of a potent anti-toxin serum Can be diluted into multiple long-term salves and other medicinal items.

ThingDef.label: Surgesap
ThingDef.description:
A jar of terrasap containing a sap that is highly reactive to the world around it. It's makeup allows it a limited form of compression, which is exploited through weapons it in infused into. 

When surgesap is present within a weapon, the 'trigger' can be held to begin a reaction. Normally this wouldn't result in anything, but weapons with surgesap will internally 'build up' the ammo generation while the trigger is held. After release, the result is a violent, fast torrent of projectiles. 
Surgesap is quite rare, and it's methods of growth is currently unknown, making it's primary source of acquisition either from a Terratech faction, or from a Spectra Tree. Surgesap is considered a "Protosap", allowing it to be compatible with all genomes. 

Use cases: Allows matured ranged weapons to fire a spray of projectiles at once. The amount varies, and the weapon will be unable to perform this again for a few hours. Infusing a weapon with this sap comes at a cost; the high focus on ammo generation means that the lifespan is slightly decreased.
